name: customer-complaint-intelligence
description: Bounded Codex skills for complaint intelligence plus an isolated Customer Complaint Demo bootstrapper.

interface.shortDescription: Turn complaint emails into evidence and action.
interface.longDescription: Five bounded skills help a human create an isolated complaint demo capsule, extract complaint data from Gmail, analyze it with local customer data, investigate findings through source emails, and apply approved labels back to Gmail.
defaultPrompt: Turn my Gmail complaints into a structured CSV.
Analyze the complaint register with my customer data.
Show the emails supporting this finding.
Initialize the isolated Customer Complaint Demo.
